title: Ethereal Dreams
description: A short film exploring the boundaries between reality and the subconscious. This project utilized dream-like visuals and a non-linear narrative to evoke a sense of wonder.

title: Oceanic Hues
description: A color grading project focused on enhancing the natural beauty of underwater footage. The grade aimed to bring out vibrant blues and greens while maintaining a realistic look.

title: Concrete Jungle
description: A documentary-style film capturing the energy and rhythm of city life over a 24-hour period. Features dynamic camera work and a powerful soundscape.
